subject: Action required: your password expires in 3 days
body: Hi, our records show your Acme SSO password will expire in 3 days. Please reset it from the employee portal before it locks you out of email and VPN. No action needed if you've already changed it this week.

subject: Heads up: office WiFi maintenance tonight

subject: Benefits enrollment closes Friday

subject: Please sign the updated NDA by end of week

subject: Board meeting prep — need your slides
body: I'm finalizing the deck for Thursday's board meeting and I still need your team's roadmap slides. Can you send me the latest version by tomorrow morning so I have time to weave it into the full deck? Let me know if you're stuck on anything.

subject: Concerns about the revised pricing terms
body: We reviewed the updated contract and have concerns about the 12% price increase on renewal. This wasn't discussed in our last call and we'd like to understand the reasoning before signing. Please reach out to me directly at raj.malhotra@northwindtrading.com so we can resolve this before the renewal date.
